sentences.zh: 我会说，这是一种直白的嚎叫。

sentences.en: The thing is, I hated this album the first time, the first couple times I listened to it.
sentences.zh: 问题是，这张专辑我第一次听，甚至前几次听的时候，我都讨厌它。

sentences.en: And I put it on five times this weekend.
sentences.zh: 但这周末我连着听了五遍。

sentences.en: And it might actually be, like, I just need to dunk my head into the bucket.
sentences.zh: 也许我只是需要让自己沉浸进去，适应一下。

sentences.en: Because the more I listened to it, the more I was okay with it.
sentences.zh: 因为听得越多，我越能接受它。

sentences.en: And then maybe the more even I started to like it.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能越听越喜欢。

sentences.en: I don't know that I will ever appreciate his voice, which is his God-given voice.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己是否能欣赏他的嗓音，尽管那是上天赐予他的声音。

sentences.en: All respect to his voice.
sentences.zh: 对他嗓音本身我表示尊重。

sentences.en: But there is a hurdle.
sentences.zh: 但确实有一道门槛。

sentences.en: There is a hurdle to this.
sentences.zh: 这东西有一道门槛。

sentences.en: It is slightly, it's like Kermit Cilantro, is what it is.
sentences.zh: 它有点像……怎么说呢，就像科米蛙唱香菜。

sentences.en: I would like to see that Muppet, actually.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我还挺想见见那个布偶的。

sentences.en: The Cameron Winter Muppet?
sentences.zh: 那个卡梅伦·温特的布偶？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: He's definitely going to be on Sesame Street at some point, right?
sentences.zh: 他迟早会出现在《芝麻街》里，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I think that would disturb the children.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那会吓坏小孩子的。

sentences.en: I don't know much.
sentences.zh: 我了解得不多。

sentences.en: So I feel like I'm in the middle, moving slightly Lindsay's direction.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉自己处于中间地带，正稍微向琳赛那边靠拢。

sentences.en: Welcome.
sentences.zh: 欢迎加入。

sentences.en: Karen is out, out, out.
sentences.zh: 凯伦是彻底拒绝，完全不接受。

sentences.en: I'm so out.
sentences.zh: 我绝对不接受。

sentences.en: I don't know what this album, I mean, I think I know what this album is trying to do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这张专辑……我是说，我想我明白这张专辑想表达什么。

sentences.en: And it is trying to conjure the spirit of 70s, 60s, 70s New York bands.
sentences.zh: 它试图唤起六七十年代纽约乐队的精神。

sentences.en: And it just doesn't do it for me at all.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说完全没用。

sentences.en: And I did try repeated listenings this weekend in an attempt to say, am I just not giving it enough time?
sentences.zh: 这周末我反复试听，就是想问问自己：是不是我给它的时间还不够？

sentences.en: I think I hated it more every time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我每听一次就更讨厌它一点。

sentences.en: There's just shadows of the music that I like in it.
sentences.zh: 里面确实有我喜欢的音乐的影子。

sentences.en: And I don't want to discount the fact that for a lot of people, Gen Z and younger, this is their first interfacing with these sounds.
sentences.zh: 我不想忽视这样一个事实：对于许多Z世代及更年轻的人来说，这是他们第一次接触这些声音。

sentences.en: And they're finding them thrilling.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这些声音很刺激。

sentences.en: And I think that is awesome.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很棒。

sentences.en: So I don't want to be like a crazy old ageist, you know, fuddy-duddy here and be like, ah, it was all better in the old days.
sentences.zh: 所以我不想表现得像个疯狂的、有年龄歧视的老古董，说什么“过去的东西才是最好的”。

sentences.en: The music that these people are drawing on is very valuable.
sentences.zh: 这些人借鉴的音乐非常有价值。

sentences.en: You know, we're talking about Lou Reed's Suicide Television.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们谈论的是卢·里德的《自杀电视》。

sentences.en: I mean, these are wonderful sources.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这些都是很棒的素材。

sentences.en: To me, they're not doing it successfully.
sentences.zh: 但在我看来，他们做得并不成功。

sentences.en: It just feels like a mishmash to me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就像个大杂烩。

sentences.en: But I think it's interesting just how divisive it is.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得它引发的争议本身就很有趣。

sentences.en: And that's part of, I don't want to say that's part of what I like about it, because I do just love this record.
sentences.zh: 我不想说这就是我喜欢它的原因，因为我确实就是喜欢这张唱片。

sentences.en: But I think it's refreshing that an indie rock band from New York is getting this much of a rise out of people and a reaction, you know, whether you love it or hate it.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，一支纽约独立摇滚乐队能引起人们这么大的反响和讨论，无论你是爱是恨，这都让人耳目一新。

sentences.en: And I think another trend we want to discuss is it was actually a good year for rock?
sentences.zh: 我想我们还要讨论另一个趋势：今年其实是摇滚乐的好年头？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Question mark?
sentences.zh: 打个问号？

sentences.en: I mean, for me, it's always kind of a good year for rock.
sentences.zh: 我是说，对我而言，摇滚乐年年都是好年头。

sentences.en: Sure, but I think something that I really embrace about Geese, too, is, you know, every year, every few years that you get the think pieces, is rock music dead?
sentences.zh: 当然，但我认为Geese乐队让我非常欣赏的一点是，每隔几年就会出现那种“摇滚乐已死”的深度评论。

sentences.en: But I think this was a year when a lot of younger bands were finding ways to make rock
sentences.zh: 但我觉得今年有很多年轻乐队找到了制作摇滚乐的方法，

sentences.en: music that resonated with their cohort and that felt somehow new and novel and like a distinct approach to it.
sentences.zh: 这些音乐能引起同龄人的共鸣，感觉既新颖又独特，是一种截然不同的尝试。

sentences.en: Something about Geese, when I saw them live last month, people were crowd surfing to the ballads.
sentences.zh: 关于Geese，上个月我看他们现场时，人们竟然在民谣环节玩起了人群冲浪。

sentences.en: I've never seen that before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从没见过这种场面。

sentences.en: You know, there was such an energy there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那里的能量太强了。

sentences.en: Can you hear my eye roll?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我翻白眼的声音吗？

sentences.en: Karen, how can you not appreciate this enthusiasm?
sentences.zh: 凯伦，你怎么能不欣赏这种热情呢？

sentences.en: Listen, I love excitement for indie rock.
sentences.zh: 听着，我热爱独立摇滚的激情。

sentences.en: That's awesome.
sentences.zh: 那很棒。

sentences.en: Before we move on, let's talk about one other New York rock band.
sentences.zh: 在继续之前，我们来聊聊另一支纽约摇滚乐队。

sentences.en: I think maybe that you can come in agreement on this one.
sentences.zh: 我想在这支乐队上你们应该能达成共识。

sentences.en: We both like this one.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都喜欢这支乐队。

sentences.en: Tell us about it.
sentences.zh: 给我们介绍一下吧。

sentences.en: The band is Water From Your Eyes.
sentences.zh: 这支乐队叫“眼中水”。

sentences.en: Or as my boyfriend calls them, tears.
sentences.zh: 或者像我男朋友叫他们的那样，“泪水”。

sentences.en: I get the joke.
sentences.zh: 我懂这个梗。

sentences.en: Water From Your Eyes is essentially a duo of Nate Amos and Rachel Brown.
sentences.zh: “眼中水”本质上是由内特·阿莫斯和瑞秋·布朗组成的二人组。

sentences.en: Nate Amos wailing away on the guitar on this record.
sentences.zh: 内特·阿莫斯在这张唱片里把吉他弹得震天响。

sentences.en: Lots of layered, distortion, just big, crunchy guitar songs, which I know is something Karen and I both enjoy.
sentences.zh: 大量的分层、失真，就是那种宏大、清脆的吉他曲，我知道凯伦和我都很喜欢这种风格。

sentences.en: And Rachel Brown sings, in quotes, with this deadpan, just really interesting lyrics, almost kind of spoken word poetry.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋·布朗的演唱，怎么说呢，带着一种冷幽默，歌词非常有趣，几乎像是口语诗。

sentences.en: They're funny.
sentences.zh: 它们很幽默。

sentences.en: They're dark.
sentences.zh: 它们很黑暗。

sentences.en: They're about these apocalyptic times that we live in.
sentences.zh: 它们讲述了我们所处的这个末日时代。

sentences.en: And something about those two energies coming together makes for really compelling music.
sentences.zh: 这两种能量的碰撞，造就了非常引人入胜的音乐。

sentences.en: I think this is, in some ways, an alternative rock 90s record made by people that did not live through the alternative rock 90s.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在某种程度上，这是一张由没经历过90年代另类摇滚的人制作的90年代另类摇滚唱片。

sentences.en: And there's something really satisfying about that.
sentences.zh: 这让人感到非常满足。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: To me, this is the exciting Brooklyn band at the moment.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是目前最令人兴奋的布鲁克林乐队。

sentences.en: Lindsay, I'd love for you to talk about one more trend that appeared on your list this year.
sentences.zh: 琳赛，我想请你再聊聊今年出现在你榜单上的另一个趋势。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: I noticed when putting my list together, only afterwards, that there were a lot of British women making interesting pop music this year.
sentences.zh: 我在整理榜单时才注意到，今年有很多英国女性在创作有趣的流行音乐。

sentences.en: And pop music under a very large umbrella.
sentences.zh: 而且是在一个非常广义的流行音乐范畴下。

sentences.en: I'll start by talking about, I think, my 10th favorite album of the year, Fancy That by Pink Pantheris.
sentences.zh: 我先从我今年第十喜欢的专辑说起，PinkPantheress的《Fancy That》。

sentences.en: This is a quick, I think, 20-minute album.
sentences.zh: 这是一张很短的专辑，大概20分钟吧。

sentences.en: So if you couldn't get through swag on the Morgan Mullen record, if you don't have the attention span, do I have a recommendation for you.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你听不完摩根·穆伦那张唱片，如果你注意力不够集中，那我有个推荐给你。

sentences.en: I think Pink Pantheris is someone who came on the scene a few years ago, had a very distinct sound as both a producer and a vocalist,
sentences.zh: 我觉得PinkPantheress几年前刚出道时，作为制作人和歌手都有非常独特的风格，

sentences.en: but seemed like she kind of had one lane and one sound that she was doing really well.
sentences.zh: 但看起来她当时似乎只有一种路线和一种风格，而且做得很好。

sentences.en: And this album feels really refreshing to me.
sentences.zh: 而这张专辑让我感觉非常耳目一新。

sentences.en: This is her doing something a lot lighter, more effervescent, kind of flirty.
sentences.zh: 这是她尝试了一些更轻快、更活泼、更俏皮的东西。

sentences.en: A lot of her songs previously were about heartbreak, but this is almost a concept album that tells the story of this burgeoning romance.
sentences.zh: 她以前的很多歌都是关于心碎的，但这几乎是一张讲述萌芽期浪漫故事的概念专辑。

sentences.en: It's really good.
sentences.zh: 它真的很棒。

sentences.en: And it shows a side of her that I think was maybe, I was not sure was there.
sentences.zh: 它展现了她不为人知的一面。

sentences.en: It's an artist who, going back to this idea of how do you follow breakthroughs and how do you continue to develop your artistry in an industry that is moving so faSt.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起一个艺术家在突破之后该如何发展，以及在节奏如此之快的行业中如何继续提升艺术造诣。

sentences.en: I think this just finds her shifting into another gear that I was not aware she had, and I think it's a delightful record.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这张专辑让她切换到了我从未察觉到的新档位，我认为这是一张令人愉悦的唱片。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people have been trying to sound like her over the past few years.
sentences.zh: 我觉得过去几年很多人都在模仿她的声音。

sentences.en: She's got like, you know, sort of a high-pitched, breathy vocal, and her, you know, tracks are generally pretty upbeat dance music.
sentences.zh: 她有一种高音、气声的唱法，而且她的曲目通常是相当欢快的舞曲。

sentences.en: Like, you know, Lily Allen bit her on one of the songs on the new album.
sentences.zh: 就像莉莉·艾伦在新专辑里的一首歌里就借鉴了她。

sentences.en: There's a bunch of stuff.
sentences.zh: 有很多类似的情况。

sentences.en: So I thought, I love this record, too.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，我也很喜欢这张唱片。

sentences.en: Also 20 minutes, incredible length.
sentences.zh: 同样是20分钟，时长太完美了。

sentences.en: And yeah, these songs definitely have more of an effervescence to them.
sentences.zh: 没错，这些歌确实更有活力。

sentences.zh: 我还想指出，琳赛在上一张专辑时采访过PinkPantheress，结果在过山车上差点吐了。

sentences.zh: 她人很好，她说，我觉得了解自己的极限是件好事之类的。

sentences.zh: 然后她又去坐了五次过山车，而我就站在旁边看着她。

sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这时间利用得太棒了。

sentences.zh: 凯伦，你提到了莉莉·艾伦。

sentences.en: I feel like this was quite a tabloid moment when she released this album late this fall.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她在今年秋末发行这张专辑时，确实引起了不小的轰动。

sentences.en: I can't believe that the zeitgeist has swung back to Lily Allen.
sentences.zh: 我真不敢相信时代潮流又回到了莉莉·艾伦身上。

sentences.en: And that's her album in a nutshell, except it's ostensibly autobiographical about the dissolution of her marriage and her cheating husband.

sentences.zh: 我能问你一首你榜单上的歌吗？我这个周末刚听了。

sentences.zh: 欢迎来到Gilbert Cruz的世界。

sentences.en: I'm special, special, special.
sentences.zh: 我很特别，特别，特别。

sentences.en: Can I ask a question?
sentences.zh: 我可以问个问题吗？

sentences.en: No, but yes.
sentences.zh: 不行，但可以。

sentences.en: Was there a Kidz Bop version of a song in there?
sentences.zh: 里面有Kidz Bop版本的歌吗？

sentences.en: I do not believe so.
sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Lindsay.
sentences.zh: 琳赛。

sentences.en: Yes, I did ring in.
sentences.zh: 是的，我按铃了。

sentences.en: I heard Fame is a Gun by Addison Rae.
sentences.zh: 我听到了Addison Rae的《Fame is a Gun》。

sentences.en: That is correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: Somewhere in there.
sentences.zh: 就在里面某处。

sentences.en: And then Automatic by Dijon.
sentences.zh: 然后是Dijon的《Automatic》。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: But Ordinary.
sentences.zh: 但是是《Ordinary》。

sentences.en: That's what I was going to say.
sentences.zh: 我本来想说这个。

sentences.en: Ordinary by Alex Warren.
sentences.zh: Alex Warren的《Ordinary》。

sentences.en: I thought it was Kidz Bop Ordinary.
sentences.zh: 我以为是Kidz Bop版的《Ordinary》。

sentences.en: This is like watching a wine critic swirl a nice, you know, full, and then say, I detect notes of Ordinary by Alex Warren.
sentences.zh: 这就像看一个红酒评论家摇晃着酒杯，然后说，我闻到了Alex Warren《Ordinary》的味道。

sentences.en: Did I also hear Sunday Special by Gilbert Cruz?
sentences.zh: 我还听到了Gilbert Cruz的《Sunday Special》吗？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: That counts for a point.
sentences.zh: 那算一分。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, now you've destroyed me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在你彻底击败我了。

sentences.en: And the last song was Sugar on My Tongue by Tyler, the creator.
sentences.zh: 最后一首歌是Tyler, the Creator的《Sugar on My Tongue》。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: That was the end of the round and the end of the game.
sentences.zh: 这一轮结束了，游戏也结束了。

sentences.en: And our producers are telling me that Lindsay won.
sentences.zh: 制作人告诉我琳赛赢了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Lindsay Zolens, you have won.
sentences.zh: 琳赛·佐伦斯，你赢了。

sentences.en: Again.
sentences.zh: 又是你。

sentences.en: Again.
sentences.zh: 又是你。

sentences.en: I'm undefeated.
sentences.zh: 我可是不败的。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: You win something.
sentences.zh: 你有奖品。

sentences.en: I think you already know what you're going to get.
sentences.zh: 我想你已经知道你会得到什么了。

sentences.en: Oh, boy.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Karen has not seen one of these.
sentences.zh: 凯伦还没见过这个。

sentences.en: Now I'm just disappointed in myself.
sentences.zh: 现在我对自己感到失望了。

sentences.en: So, as you can see, this is a cardboard box that I think we got out of the recycling.
sentences.zh: 如你们所见，这是一个我们从回收站里捡来的纸板箱。

sentences.en: And in that box is a cheap plastic trophy with my wrinkled face on it.
sentences.zh: 盒子里是一个印着我那张皱巴巴脸的廉价塑料奖杯。

sentences.en: We call it the Gilby.
sentences.zh: 我们叫它“吉尔比”。

sentences.en: Yay.
sentences.zh: 耶。

sentences.en: Congratulations.
sentences.zh: 恭喜。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm going to put it next to my other Gilby, which is on my desk.
sentences.zh: 我要把它放在我桌上另一个吉尔比旁边。

sentences.en: Karen, come see.
sentences.zh: 凯伦，来看看。

sentences.en: I will visit right after.
sentences.zh: 我马上就去。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Visit my Gilby.
sentences.zh: 去看看我的吉尔比。

sentences.en: You know, I actually do not have a Gilby.
sentences.zh: 你知道，其实我并没有吉尔比。

sentences.en: Oh, well, you are a Gilby.
sentences.zh: 噢，好吧，你就是一个吉尔比。

sentences.en: Can I borrow yours?
sentences.zh: 我能借用一下你的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, you can.
sentences.zh: 可以啊，没问题。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I have one to spare.
sentences.zh: 我正好有一个多余的。

sentences.en: Oh, you're really rubbing it in now.
sentences.zh: 噢，你现在可真是在往我伤口上撒盐啊。

sentences.en: Lindsay, thank you so much for coming on the Sunday special to talk about the year in music.
sentences.zh: 琳赛，非常感谢你能来参加周日特别节目，和我们聊聊这一年的音乐。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: Karen, thank you so much for coming on.
sentences.zh: 凯伦，非常感谢你能来。

sentences.en: Thank you, Gilbert.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，吉尔伯特。

sentences.zh: 我们的节目由温迪·多尔剪辑，罗文·内米斯托负责工程制作。

sentences.zh: 原创音乐由丹·鲍威尔和黛安·王创作。

sentences.zh: 下周，我们将聊聊这一年的电视节目。

sentences.zh: 到时见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。
